Background Knowledge  | |  | Scorpion | 1 | . |   | Scorpions |   | are |   | diurnal |   | and |   | nocturnal |   | animals | . |   | They |   | like |   | tides |   | and |   | are |   | afraid |   | of |   | dryness, |   | and |   | like |   | darkness |   | and |   | are |   | afraid |   | of |   | strong |   | light |   | stimulation | . |   | They |   | like |   | to |   | live |   | in |   | groups, |   | like |   | to |   | be |   | quiet |   | and |   | not |   | active, |   | and |   | have |   | the |   | habit |   | of |   | knowing |   | their |   | nests |   | and |   | groups | . | 2 | . |   | Scorpions |   | have |   | the |   | habit |   | of |   | hibernating | . |   | They |   | usually |   | emerge |   | from |   | hibernation |   | in |   | mid | - | to | - | late |   | April, |   | that |   | is, |   | after |   | the |   | wake |   | of |   | hibernation, |   | and |   | slowly |   | begin |   | to |   | hibernate |   | in |   | early |   | November | . |   | They |   | are |   | active |   | for |   | about |   | 6 |   | months |   | throughout |   | the |   | year | . | 3 | . |   | Although |   | scorpions |   | are |   | cold | - | blooded |   | animals, |   | they |   | are |   | still |   | relatively |   | cold | - |   | and |   | heat | - | resistant | . |   | Scorpions |   | can |   | survive |   | when |   | the |   | temperature |   | of |   | the |   | external |   | environment |   | is |   | between |   | 40 | ° | C |   | and |   | minus |   | 5 | ° | C | .
